text: Focus mode on. I'll keep my wire quiet.

Timer's on my mat. No jokes, no tips, no nagging.
Deep work time. I'm practically furniture now.
Go get 'em. I'll be right here, being silent and shiny.
Focus started. Pretend I'm not here. (I'm very good at that.)
Time! You did it. That was a proper focus round.
Ding! Round complete. I'm so proud I could bend.
And... done! Look at you, concentrating like a pro.
It looks like you finished a whole focus round. Impressive!
Time's up, hero. Take a bow. Or a break.
Focus complete! I kept quiet the whole time. Did you notice?
Round finished! Confetti would be on the budget, but I have sparkles.
That's the timer! Great work. What next?
Break time! Stand up, sip some water, look at something far away.
Good call. Rest your eyes, shake out your hands, I'll watch the desk.
Enjoy it! Stretch your legs, you've earned a breather.
Off you go. I'll be here when you're ready for round two.
